newsitem.title: CHINA: China's PICC first half premiums soar 40 percent.
newsitem.headline: China's PICC first half premiums soar 40 percent.

text.p: Premium income of the People's Insurance Company of China (PICC) soared a year-on-year 40 percent in the first half of 1997 to hit 42.8 billion yuan ($5.16 billion), the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

Premium income from PICC's life insurance business had skyrocketed 707.5 percent in the first six months from the same period a year ago to reach 18.1 billion yuan, Xinhua quoted company president Ma Yongwei as saying.
Property premium income hit 21 billion yuan in the half, up 9.4 percent from the year-ago period, Ma said.
The company paid 16.7 billion yuan in claims in the first half and was China's largest insurer, holding more than 70 percent of the country's insurance market, Ma said but gave no further details.
PICC earlier said it paid a total of 4.29 billion yuan in claims in the first three months of the year.
